requirements.checkable: RaffleFactory stores its configuration (quoteToken, vrfWrapper, protocolTreasury, raffleImplementation, and VRF constants) in immutable or constant variables with no mutating functions.
requirements.quote: Ethereum NFT raffle; immutable factory

requirements.checkable: RaffleFactory deploys each raffle via ERC-1167 minimal proxy cloning (Clones.clone) targeting an immutable Raffle implementation contract whose own state is locked in its constructor.
requirements.quote: ERC-1167 clones with immutable implementation.

requirements.checkable: ENTRY_PRICE is 1,000,000 raw units, RaffleFactory enforces quoteToken.decimals() == 6 on deployment, and buyEntries transfers entryCount * 1,000,000 quoteToken units from the buyer.
requirements.quote: One entry costs 1,000,000 units of canonical six-decimal USDC.

requirements.checkable: Each buyEntries call mints one sequential ERC-721 ticket storing the contiguous inclusive entry range [totalEntries_before + 1, totalEntries_before + entryCount], and tickets are transferable via standard ERC-721 transfers.
requirements.quote: One purchase mints a transferable ERC721 ticket representing a contiguous inclusive range.

requirements.checkable: createRaffle atomically clones, initializes, transfers the single configured ERC-721 prize into the clone, and verifies clone ownership and Active status in the same transaction, while onERC721Received rejects any other ERC-721 deposit.
requirements.quote: Exactly one ERC721 prize is escrowed atomically at creation.

requirements.checkable: When totalEntries >= reserveEntries, the raffle resolves to Status.NftWon, allows the winning ticket owner to redeem the escrowed NFT, allocates 5% (500/10,000) of unsettledPot to protocolFees, and allocates the remaining 95% to sponsorProceeds.
requirements.quote: Reserve met awards NFT and 95% sponsor / 5% treasury.

requirements.checkable: When totalEntries < reserveEntries, the raffle resolves to Status.CashWon and settlement allocates 80% (8,000/10,000) of unsettledPot to winnerProceeds, 5% (500/10,000) to protocolFees, and the remaining 15% to sponsorProceeds (while allowing the sponsor to recover the NFT prize).
requirements.quote: Reserve missed awards 80% gross to winner, 15% sponsor, 5% treasury.

requirements.checkable: In Status.Refunding, refundTickets pays 100% of ENTRY_PRICE per entry represented by burned tickets and releaseSponsorPrize returns the escrowed ERC-721 prize to sponsorRecipient.
requirements.quote: Refund outcome pays 100% per entry and returns prize.

requirements.checkable: protocolFee is computed once on the aggregate unsettledPot using floor division Math.mulDiv(grossPot, PROTOCOL_FEE_BPS, BPS).
requirements.quote: Rounding is floor on aggregate protocol fee

requirements.checkable: In _settleWinningTicket, sponsorAmount is computed by subtracting protocolFee (and cashAmount in CashWon) from grossPot so that winnerProceeds + sponsorProceeds + protocolFees equals the entire unsettledPot with zero unallocated remainder.
requirements.quote: remainder must be allocated without loss.

requirements.checkable: Neither RaffleFactory nor Raffle defines an administrator/owner role, any post-initialization configuration setter, pause/rescue privilege, or any upgrade mechanism.
requirements.quote: No administrator, mutable configuration or upgrade.

requirements.checkable: requestDraw reverts when block.timestamp < endTime and when block.timestamp >= endTime + 2 days, permitting VRF draw requests only within [endTime, endTime + 2 days).
requirements.quote: Request window [sale end, end+2days)

requirements.checkable: fulfillRandomWords ignores callbacks when block.timestamp >= drawRequestedAt + 2 days and only resolves the raffle when block.timestamp < drawRequestedAt + 2 days.
requirements.quote: callback accepted strictly before request timestamp+2days.

requirements.checkable: enableRefunds transitions the raffle to Status.Refunding only once the applicable deadline (endTime, drawRequestDeadline, or callbackDeadline) has been reached.
requirements.quote: Refunds open at deadline.

requirements.checkable: fulfillRandomWords only records winningEntry, resolvedAt, and status (NftWon or CashWon) and emits an event, performing no ticket search, liability settlement, external call, or asset transfer.
requirements.quote: Callback records result only.

requirements.checkable: settleWinningTicket is callable by any address without caller-ownership checks and only updates contract storage variables without transferring ERC-20 or ERC-721 assets.
requirements.quote: Settlement is permissionless, storage-only

requirements.checkable: redeemWinningTicket verifies msg.sender == ownerOf(ticketId) and reverts with NotTicketOwner if called by any address other than the current ticket owner.
requirements.quote: redemption requires current ticket owner

requirements.checkable: redeemWinningTicket atomically burns the winning ERC-721 ticket (_burn(ticketId)) and sets winnerRedeemed = true in the same transaction that delivers the prize or cash payout.
requirements.quote: burns claim atomically

requirements.checkable: If NFT transfer, post-transfer ownerOf verification, or quoteToken transfer fails during redeemWinningTicket, the entire redemption transaction reverts, undoing the ticket burn and all state changes.
requirements.quote: must revert all effects on delivery failure.

requirements.checkable: After settlement allocates sponsorProceeds and protocolFees, releaseSponsorProceeds and releaseProtocolFees can each be called independently in any order without requiring the other party or the winner to claim first.
requirements.quote: Sponsor and treasury can claim independently after settlement.

requirements.checkable: Raffle clones reject any ticket mint/transfer, quoteToken payout, prizeToken configuration, or recipient configuration targeting another registered raffle clone (isRaffle[destination]).
requirements.quote: Never move assets between raffle clones.

requirements.checkable: quoteToken and vrfWrapper are configured once as immutable contract references validated for deployed code (and 6 decimals for quoteToken) in the RaffleFactory constructor.
requirements.quote: Quote token and Chainlink wrapper are trusted canonical dependencies

requirements.checkable: External interactions involving arbitrary prizeToken contracts and ticket recipients are guarded by nonReentrant modifiers, strict onERC721Received validation, post-transfer ownerOf verification, and storage-only callback/settlement isolated from pull claims.
requirements.quote: arbitrary prize contracts and ticket recipients are untrusted.

requirements.checkable: Too vague/off-chain to verify from smart contract code alone insofar as it describes frontend discovery architecture; on-chain contracts expose view getters and events without accepting off-chain discovery inputs.
requirements.quote: Frontend discovery is advisory

requirements.checkable: On-chain state-changing functions read live chain state (status, block.timestamp, ownerOf, totalEntries, live VRF fee) during execution; insofar as this requires off-chain clients/frontends to reread chain state before submitting transactions, it cannot be verified from contract code alone.
requirements.quote: transaction decisions must reread current chain state.
